lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
The federal budget unveiled last week includes measures aimed at reducing paperwork and benefits for musicians and writers, CP24 reports.
Republicans elect Trump ally Jim Jordan as new US House minority leader, Al Jazeera reports.
Four grizzly bears involved in deadly attack on mother and daughter in B.C, The Canadian Press reports.
NYT: Trump wished Biden well in newly disclosed 2021 letter, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
